tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Window glass. The main dark ground: transom, hero panes, Design Studio band. Frost and leaf text sit on it (≥8:1).

tokens.name: glass-2
tokens.usage: Second glass tone: the bulkhead under the window, event card, closed-sign fill.

tokens.name: sash
tokens.usage: Painted window sash. Mullions between every section and pane, header, footer. Never a text color on glass.

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: Gilt (gold leaf; silver leaf in winter, copper in harvest). Sign-painted lettering, primary buttons, keylines, the Visit band ground. Sash text on it.

tokens.name: shade
tokens.usage: The painted drop shade under gilt lettering. Decorative only: never text.

tokens.name: ornament
tokens.usage: Season accent: cranberry, ice, peony, mustard. The season band and the OPEN sign. Use on-ornament for text on it.

tokens.name: on-ornament
tokens.usage: Text on ornament. Light in holiday, dark in the other seasons (each ≥4.5:1).

tokens.name: frost
tokens.usage: Frosted white. Body text on glass; the light ground of the Collective section (sash text on it).

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Muted text on glass and glass-2: secondary lines, labels, captions (≥7:1 on glass).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between buttons; tag gaps.

tokens.name: mullion
tokens.usage: Sash bar width between panes and between every section (fluid from 8px on phones).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Paragraph to controls; caption inset.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Bulkhead padding; card padding.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page side margin on desktop (fluid down to 20px).

tokens.name: section
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of full-width bands (fluid down to 48px).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, focus rings, today badge.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, season swatches. Painted wood, not pills.

tokens.name: radius-sign
tokens.usage: The hanging OPEN/CLOSED sign.

tokens.name: shadow-sign
tokens.usage: Hanging sign lifted off the sash.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: Gilt button resting on glass.

tokens.name: gilt-shade
tokens.usage: Text-shadow under gilt lettering (use the shade color of the season). Lettering only.
